title: Integration test uses raw SQL string interpolation (test-only, no production pattern modeled)
detail: New integration tests concatenate app_id UUIDs into raw SQL strings. Test-only (local Docker DB, UUID inputs from seed helpers), no production impact — production uses Squirrel parameterized queries exclusively.
recommended_fix: Accept as test-only convenience; no production pattern to fix. Flag if this interpolation idiom migrates into non-test code.
